laceration near lateral eyelid requiring simple suture (3 stitches)

losses.description: Soft tissue injury and discomfort/irritation in the neck and lower back following the collision affecting the 1st Plaintiff (substantially resolved upon physiotherapy and medical treatments).
Back and right forearm injury to the 1st Plaintiff.
Neck pain and related soft tissue discomfort of the 2nd Plaintiff.
Left upper arm/forearm abrasion and pain of the 2nd Plaintiff.
Slight scar from right eyelid laceration of the 3rd Plaintiff (at trial the slight scar was almost not noticeable).
Superficial abrasions over bilateral knees of the 3rd Plaintiff.
